name: fluent-fork
description: Local fork of Fluent (originally by Mohammad Kermani) with bugfixes: accuracy-metric consistency and fluent-learn routing. AI Language Learning Kit. Personal AI tutor for any target language. Uses spaced repetition (SM-2), active recall, adaptive difficulty, and tracking across 6 databases. Daily practice: /fluent-review, /fluent-vocab, /fluent-writing, /fluent-speaking, /fluent-reading, /fluent-learn. Start with /fluent-setup.
